name: Eva Live Inc. Common Stock
summary: Eva Live, Inc. is a technology enterprise based in the United States, focused on creating an automated and intelligent platform for managing advertising campaigns. Its core product, the Eva Platform, empowers advertisers to acquire digital advertising inventory across diverse online channels, thereby connecting with their desired demographics. The company also operates the Eva XML Platform, which procures web traffic from various sources and subsequently distributes it to landing pages featuring advertisements via XML feeds. Complementing these platforms, Eva Live, Inc. delivers additional advertising and branding services, including the development of custom landing pages, websites, widget designs, and banner creative. Established in 2015, the firm's headquarters are situated in Los Angeles, California.
